correctness.rationale: For each m≥1, Ω²=m²+1, Ec=Ω²/2 and E>0, the odd continuous Lipschitz restoring force has coercive even C¹ potential, yielding unique simple closed energy curves away from E=0. For E>Ec, interface velocity s=√(2(E−Ec)) and shifted outer harmonic coordinate z=x+m⁻² give physical quarter-times arctan(Ω/s)/Ω and arctan(ms/Ω²)/m. Independently differentiating yields dT/ds=4s²/[(s²+Ω²)(m²s²+Ω⁴)]>0 and T'(E)=4s/[(s²+Ω²)(m²s²+Ω⁴)]. Taylor expansion at s→0 gives T−2π/Ω=4s³/(3Ω⁶)+O(s⁵) and Θ=2s/(πΩ)+O(s³), hence π³/(6Ω³), C¹ but not C² period and nondifferentiable Θ. Large-s expansion gives 2π/m−T=4/(m²s)+O(s⁻³) and 1−Θ=2m/(πs)+O(s⁻²). Time-of-flight parametrization conjugates time-2π sampling to a circle rotation by ρ=2π/T, continuously and strictly from Ω to m; m<Ω<m+1 rules out an integer ambiguity, all rational reduced p/q in (m,Ω) have one level and primitive period q, irrational values quasiperiodic. Expansions invert to two-thirds and inverse-square resonance edges; countable curves have planar area zero. At E=Ec touching but not crossing saturation gives Θ=0; equilibrium E=0 correctly excluded. Independent symbolic derivation plus 16 high-accuracy original-flow numerical integration cases support normalization without replacing proof.
residual_risks: No theorem for periodic forcing, damping, discontinuous signum force or higher-dimensional systems; continuous E=0 period not defined.
Finite ODE integrations and symbolic identities validate displayed formulas but not originality, the global strict sign or countable resonance statement independently of the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The model is an established natural saturated restoring-force oscillator. Its exact grazing threshold separates a physically isochronous harmonic core from a twist annulus. The cancellation of the linear time contributions creates a nonanalytic three-halves period response even as the saturated occupation rises as one-half; the parameter-exact cubic linking invariant is an informative boundary normalisation, and the two-thirds energy detuning of a dense set of resonant invariant curves connects measurable time partition to stroboscopic dynamics. This motivated sharp transition and full energy classification go beyond just a sampled computation, while the direct harmonic matching and generic rational-rotation facts are credited as elementary and not themselves claims of major new method.
residual_risks: The main computations are elementary; the resonance arithmetic itself is standard and should not be marketed as a stand-alone breakthrough.

Value depends on exact fractional grazing and occupation invariant being useful for this canonical low-regularity model; no quantitative perturbative stability or forced-system generalization is proved.
